changes: Controlled JSON graph input replaces Tauri filesystem and global project stores
Retains Sigma circular rendering, degree sizing and type/community colors; the inherited force layout is replaced by deterministic concentric rings
Scopes layouts and selection to the knowledge space and snapshot version
Adds deterministic initial positions, keyboard equivalents, node dragging and SVG fallback
Node dragging prevents Sigma's default movement without disabling the camera; native release/cancel/blur and no-button recovery prevent stuck gestures across sandbox boundaries
Restricts both Sigma and SVG to concept/entity nodes and evidence-bearing semantic edges; degree, community coloring and layout exclude reading-only page navigation
Packs real connected components into stable annotated groups, preserves isolated nodes without bridges, and supports actual one-hop labels and camera focus in both Sigma and SVG
Uses Sigma's public node-label and hover drawing callbacks plus matching SVG text placement to keep 12px labels inside the viewport, moving edge labels left and ellipsizing only when needed
Follows the parent-supplied Chinese/English locale for presentation labels, accessible names, controls and reader status while preserving all user knowledge verbatim

Removes component rectangles and repeated captions, keeps the full semantic background, projects multi-hop exploration onto real visible edges and fits the current exploration without rebuilding the graph in Sigma or SVG

Fits all current coordinates for overview and fit actions, including dragged nodes beyond the original bounds; a failed WebGL instance handles later resizes in SVG without reinitializing or resetting its geometry
Removes the upper-left relationship list from the canvas; the reader owns all directional relationship summaries and evidence

Reduces normal and highlighted semantic edge widths in Sigma and SVG while retaining color emphasis, relation weights and all interaction behavior; sets the public minEdgeThickness to 1 so Sigma does not clamp thin strokes to its inherited 1.7 default and antiAliasingFeather to 0.4 to preserve continuous readable thin strokes
Extracts upstream type/community colors, degree-based node sizing, layout iteration policy and color mixing
Uniformly scales node radii by sqrt(1/2) to halve their area while preserving all degree-based size ratios in Sigma and SVG
Further scales the existing node radii by 1/2 at the user's request, retaining relative degree and graph-density sizing in both renderers
Retains same-screen graph/article reading pattern
Replaces auto-writing WikiEditor and arbitrary file reads with read-only Markdown and exact citation requests
Preserves semantic relationship direction and distinguishes inferred relationships from ordinary Wiki page links
Keeps the full page index in a grouped reading directory, including articles, overview navigation and original sources outside the semantic canvas; shows each directional predicate and its evidence
Retains independent semantic graph context across article and exact-source reading, with return and locate controls
Follows the parent-supplied Chinese/English locale for presentation labels, accessible names, controls and reader status while preserving all user knowledge verbatim
Adds compact localized neighborhood exploration controls while retaining full article and exact-source reading context
Consolidates root-context relationships into the reader, with source/predicate/target summaries and expandable evidence retained across related article and exact-source reading
Sandboxed shared entry with versioned JSON messages and no Tauri runtime, model credentials, arbitrary paths or write API
Displays concept/entity counts and the full number of semantic statements while retaining an independent article directory for empty concept graphs

Local deterministic connected-component layout and compact packing over semantic edges only

Local one-hop visibility and highlight derivation without adding semantic graph data
